title: Coordinate Share
description: Passcode-based coordinate sharing for multiplayer servers and LAN worlds.
body:
![Coordinate Share Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/007abfae6deff4801a38b6553b75d722e3bb0ad6.png)



## What is it?
Coordinate Share is a mod that allows players on your server to access their teammates coordinates as long as they are online.

## First-time setup
Players can set an 8-digit code using `/.setcode <code>`. Players can use `/.getcode` to view their code if they ever forget. Codes will never appear in server logs.

## Functionality
Players can then give their code to their teammates and once they have all entered the same code, they will be able to see each other's coordinates by running `/.getcoords`. 
All online players on their team will also be notified if their coordinates were accessed and who in the team accessed them.
If players want to see who is on their team, they can run `/.getteam` and it will return a list of names.

## Features:
- 8-digit codes, 100,000,000 combinations 
- Players get notified whrn their coordinates are shared to keep transparency
- Players can see who is on their team at any time
- Codes are not showed in server logs or Admin chat
- Mod also works on LAN worlds, only the host needs it installed
